description: Restore a selected History version (version_id from soclo_page_versions) without changing the live gate or address. Needs the displayed if_unchanged revision. Free. Without confirm:true it returns a preview only; pass confirm:true only after the owner approves. A lost write reply must be reconciled with soclo_page_get and soclo_page_versions before retrying.

confirm.description: true only after the owner approved the exact change. Omit or pass false to get a preview: nothing is sent.

if_unchanged.description: Exact displayed site, page-list or History revision, as last read; never refresh it invisibly.

version_id.description: The exact version id returned by soclo_page_versions.

name: soclo_page_restore
title: Restore a saved website version
